correctness.rationale: For every boundary point, signed-coordinate symmetry reduces to (1,a), 0<=a<=1; y=(1,-1) forces the value at least M_nu(2,1). At x=(1,0), each y=(u,v) on the square gives max(A,B)<=2 and min(A,B)<=1 for A=||x+y||_infty, B=||x-y||_infty. Symmetry and coordinatewise monotonicity of the Heinz mean give the converse bound. The proof covers all nu in [0,1], including the continuous endpoint convention.
